title: Har ranj saha
body:
har ranj saha sadma bhi kya kya na uthaya
bazaar bhi halaat ne zainab ko dikhaya
<<DIVIDER>>
pathar to baraste thay magar aag bhi barsi
jab khaafila abid ka bazaar mein aaya
har ranj saha...
<<DIVIDER>>
har zulm pe sajjad ki aankhein to hai barsi
par shaam ke bazaar ne zyada hai rulaya
har ranj saha...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ki khatir qadam qadam pe har dard alam apnaya
thi do ta'reefaat mohamed ki usay des ba des phiraya
virse mein paak moazzama ko darbar gaya dikhlaya
par waqt ki zaalim gardish ne bibi ko khoob sataya
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch ranj to maqdooma ko virsa mein milay thay
par waqt ki gardish ne usay bahot sataya
har ranj saha...
<<DIVIDER>>
khudrat ne bibi zainab ki hai kismat khoob banayi
bhai ko marte dekh ke bhi royi na zahra jaayi
karbal se leke shaam talak rassiyon mein bandh ke aayi
afsos kisi bhi manzil pe aaraam na kar wo paayi
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke muqaddar pe hai taqdeer bhi hairaan
zindagi mein kisi lamha bhi haye chain na paaya
har ranj saha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ameer bacha deen ko to shabbir gaye thay
shabbir ko har haal mein zainab ne bachaya
har ranj saha...
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
